verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions and an official MCP server, so a scoped-credentials axis applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence describes API keys with limited permissions, per-action scopes, read-only keys, or other least-privilege credential issuance. Account lock, 2FA and Registry Lock are account-security controls, not scoped agent credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
